at 198 K, the coarser-grained structure displays ΔKth threshold of 11 MPa m i.e., ~57% higher than in the fine-grained structure

this effect in the CrCoNi MEA can be attributed to more significant crack-tip shielding due to roughness-induced crack closure (an extrinsic crack wedging effect) resulting from the rougher crack surfaces in the larger-grained material
this effect is likely associated with the reduced cyclic plasticity in the higher strength structures, which limits the intrinsic mechanism of crack advance
